---
title: "Older Documents and Current Guides"
description: "Archived np and crs documents with links to current guides and package documentation."
---

These PDFs preserve the final long-form documents shipped before the current
vignette set. They contain useful exposition and practical FAQs, but some
commands, defaults, and package-version details are historical.

::: {.callout-warning}
Use the current Gallery pages and package manuals for present APIs. Consult the
archived PDFs for background, extended discussion, and historical examples.
:::

## Archived `np` documents

These copies come from the archived CRAN
[`np` 0.60-20 package tarball](https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/np/np_0.60-20.tar.gz).

| Document | Archived copy | Pages | PDF build date |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Package `np` FAQ | [PDF](www/legacy/np_faq_0.60-20.pdf) | 56 | February 16, 2026 |
| *The np Package* | [PDF](www/legacy/np_vignette_0.60-20.pdf) | 34 | February 16, 2026 |
| *Entropy-Based Inference using R and the np Package: A Primer* | [PDF](www/legacy/np_entropy_0.60-20.pdf) | 11 | February 16, 2026 |

Current package documentation:

- [`np` vignette index on CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/np/vignettes/)
- [`np_getting_started`](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/np/vignettes/np_getting_started.html)
- [`np_entropy_tests`](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/np/vignettes/np_entropy_tests.html)
